The ideal candidate will assess existing digital environments, define modernization strategies, and guide organizations in adopting scalable, agile, and future-ready digital solutions aligned with business objectives.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
7+ years of experience in IT consulting, digital transformation, enterprise architecture, or technology modernization.
Proven experience in digital platform modernization and enterprise transformation initiatives.
Cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud).
Legacy system modernization and application migration.
Enterprise application platforms and digital ecosystems.
Experience developing modernization roadmaps and target-state architectures.
Strong business analysis, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.

d: A part of Kerzner International, a global leader in luxury hospitality, Atlantis, The Palm is a world where iconic stays, legendary adventures, and the boldest flavours all come together to transport guests to A World Away.

The iconic resort, located on the crescent of Palm Island, features 1,544 Rooms, Suites, and Signature Suites, each designed with thoughtful details inspired by the sea. It is the ultimate destination for world-class dining, bringing together some of the most renowned celebrity chefs and Michelin-starred restaurants. The resort is also home to unforgettable experiences, from record-breaking thrills at the world’s largest waterpark to stunning views of 65,000 marine animals in the aquarium, and close encounters with resident Indo-Pacific dolphins at Dolphin Bay.

Behind this extraordinary destination are over 6,000 colleagues from 129 nationalities. Together, we foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where talent is nurtured, wellbeing is prioritised, and careers truly thrive.

As a Driver in our transportation team you will be responsible to safely move our most discerning and valued guests, executives and VIPs to and from their destination in a smooth, comfortable and efficiently. You must have highly developed U.A.E navigational skills, be able to effectivity read maps, follow and provide directions, be able to assist with luggage while avoiding traffic-laden areas to ensure an on time safe trip every time. The Driver is responsible for creating first and farewell impressions for the organizations and acts as an invaluable ambassador of Atlantis, The Royal.

Working for Atlantis, The Royal gives you the key to a myriad of growth opportunities considering your career preferences. The possibility to cross-train within the hotel will allow you to develop your professional and personal skills to continuously learn. Passion for customer service is the driving force for this role.
q: To be eligible for this role the candidate must hold a valid UAE driving license free of infractions and min 3 years proven working experience as a driver, preferably in limousine service in a five-star environment. Computer literacy is required as well as being fluent in English, with additional languages desired. Impeccable personal presentation and grooming are essential in this role, as is the ability to read a guest social situation to deliver a discreet luxury five-star experience.
Atlantis, Dubai, offers an unbeatable opportunity to grow and develop in your career right in the mix of a continuously developing city and a diverse range of cultures.

We offer a competitive, tax-free salary paid in UAE Dirhams (AED), alongside a wealth of benefits. These include generous food and beverage privileges, exclusive discounted rates at all Kerzner properties worldwide, comprehensive health insurance (with dental coverage), annual flights home, life insurance, an incentive program, and a variety of colleague wellness and social initiatives.

With a strong emphasis on learning and development, colleagues at Atlantis enjoy access to world-class training, career mobility, and internal growth opportunities across the Kerzner portfolio - making this an ideal environment for ambitious individuals seeking a long-term, fulfilling career in luxury hospitality. Join the A-Team and discover the extraordinary.

d: Launched in Bahrain in November 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We're a team of dedicated people driving this mission by providing better, faster, and cheaper ways to access food through technology.

To function as the Kitchen Manager for the Calo Kitchen and work closely with the Head Chef to ensure all production sections operate successfully in accordance with company standards through an efficient, scalable, and modern style of kitchen management.

The Kitchen Manager will be responsible for overseeing daily kitchen production operations, ensuring the highest standards of food quality, safety, efficiency, and team performance while delivering operational excellence in a high-volume production environment.
q: Proven experience in large-scale food production operations with a focus on management roles within reputed international hotel groups, restaurant chains, airline catering, meal subscription businesses, cloud kitchens, or large catering operations.
Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field is preferred.
In-depth knowledge of Health & Safety, HACCP, ISO standards, and other relevant food safety regulations.

Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience within large-scale food production environments, including experience as a Sous Chef, Chef de Cuisine, Kitchen Manager, Production Manager, or similar leadership role.
Experience managing multicultural teams within fast-paced and high-volume production environments.
Experience managing kitchen operations serving large daily meal volumes is highly preferred.
Strong understanding of inventory management, cost control, and production planning principles.
Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and rapidly scaling production environment.
Strong knowledge of various cooking methods, ingredients, and production processes.
Strong understanding of food safety systems and quality assurance practices.
Excellent leadership and people management capabilities.
Strong commercial awareness with an understanding of food cost and operational efficiency drivers.
Familiarity with ERP systems, inventory management systems, and production reporting tools.
Excellent time management and prioritization skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality standards.
Ability to make decisions quickly and effectively under pressure.
Strong communicator with the ability to influence and engage teams at all levels.
Pleasant personality with the ability to lead, coach, and develop team members with empathy and patience.
Hands-on leader who leads by example and drives accountability.
Adaptable and comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
Passionate about food, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
r: li
Manage and oversee the end-to-end production process of the Dubai kitchen operations.
li
Ensure efficient utilization of labor, equipment, and raw materials to optimize production output while maintaining quality standards.
li
Develop and implement production plans aligned with demand forecasts and order volumes.
li
Monitor production schedules and ensure timely delivery of products in line with operational requirements.
li
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve throughput, quality, productivity, and cost efficiency.
li
Monitor and manage key operational KPIs including productivity, food cost, wastage, labor efficiency, and service levels.
li
Implement and enforce all health, safety, and food safety policies and procedures across the operation.
li
Conduct regular safety inspections and audits to identify and mitigate potential risks and hazards.
li
Ensure compliance with HACCP requirements, UAE food safety regulations, municipality requirements, and all other applicable food safety standards.
li
Implement and maintain quality control measures to ensure consistency and excellence across all menu items and production output.
li
Monitor and analyse production processes to identify opportunities for operational improvement and process optimization.
li
Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Dispatch, and Operations teams to ensure seamless operational execution.
li
Recruit, onboard, train, develop, and manage production staff while fostering a positive and collaborative working environment.
li
Provide leadership, coaching, and performance management to the team to achieve operational and production targets.
li
Ensure proper workforce planning and manpower allocation across all production sections.
li
Oversee inventory levels of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods.
li
Implement effective inventory control measures to minimize waste and optimize stock levels.
li
Ensure all equipment is properly maintained and coordinate preventative maintenance activities to minimize operational downtime.
li
Support new product launches and operational implementation of menu changes in collaboration with the Culinary and NPD teams.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We build internal systems to the same standard as our public products: specified, tested, reviewed and observable. We want engineers who enjoy that rigour and take full ownership of what they ship.
q: Treat testing, security, performance and accessibility as part of the job
Handle sensitive people data with care
Write clearly and work well in a distributed team
Own your work from first spec to production
Nice to have: Python, Go, React, Svelte, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, a history of building tools for HR, finance or operations.

The ideal candidate will use their passion for experimentation and analytics to build tomorrow’s tech organisation. This team will help us gain insights into the business and our talent pool, and use those insights to improve the experience of working at Canonical.

As a Workplace Engineer at Canonical, you need an analytical, data-driven mind and a passion to connect and make sense of interesting data from APIs. We focus heavily on the collection of metrics, optimising processes, and ways of working across Canonical. You need to demonstrate leadership, excellence, and consistency and will mentor others in the team.
r: li
Design and deliver systems and platforms, including intuitive UIs
li
Build Go services and APIs that connect many data sources
li
Design data models and architecture for connected systems
li
Turn data into clear dashboards and visualisations
li
Build LLM-powered features into everyday workflows
li
Write specs, estimate work and deliver to agreed criteria
li
Set a high bar in code review, testing and documentation
li
Partner with non-technical colleagues to turn needs into tools
li
Mentor engineers and improve how the team works
x: We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
